name: cowart
description: A native tldraw canvas for Codex, backed by cowart_mcp. Open one canvas widget per task and reuse it for Cowart workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Open a native tldraw canvas and reuse it across Cowart workflows.
interface.longDescription: Cowart brings a tldraw-powered native widget canvas into Codex for visual planning and creative iteration. The cowart_mcp server provides the canvas, project-backed state, and machine-wide UI preferences. Each task should open one native canvas widget, then reuse it for image generation, annotation editing, HTML, Slides, and other Cowart workflows without rendering duplicate tabs.
defaultPrompt: Open the Cowart canvas for this project.
Use my Cowart annotation screenshot to generate a clean revised image beside the original.
Generate a new image into the selected Cowart AI image holder.
